cases.name: default-alive-flips-default-dead
cases.description: The default-alive model's running example: $200,000 cash, $10,000 MRR growing 10% per month, $30,000 of constant monthly expenses. A $15,000-per-month hire from month 1 flips the plan from default alive to default dead: profitability moves to month 16 (1.1^m must reach 4.5) and cash crosses zero at month 7.
cases.source: Paul Graham, "Default Alive or Default Dead?" (October 2015, https://paulgraham.com/aord.html) for the model; arithmetic hand-derived in lib/openstartup/__tests__/runway.test.ts
